spec.name: Gearbox output bracket
spec.description: Bracket with a rigid gearbox attachment and a 40 N*m torque about +x, applied as a force couple through two end-face drive lugs. Top and bottom are interpreted along z; depth is y.

loads.note: Lug occupies z=64..80 mm; the lug centers are 64 mm apart.
Lug occupies z=0..16 mm; the force couple produces 40000 N*mm about +x with zero resultant force.
